title: A member who left and comes back is renewed from his page but stays hidden as archived
what: When a member who was archived returns, the desk opens his page and taps Renew or Sell membership. The plan and payment are saved, but nothing brings him back from the archive and the page gives no hint. He stays out of the Members list, the active and ending-soon counts and the message groups, while his money shows in Collections. Check in also works on an archived member without a word. Add member and Make member on Enquiries already bring such a member back, so the member page is the odd one out.
expected: Selling a plan or checking in an archived member brings him back to the list (and says so), or the page asks the desk to restore him first.
who: owners and front desk with returning members
how_often: every time a returning member is renewed from his page
fix_line: When a plan is sold to an archived member, bring him back and say so.

title: Past imports and help questions show a day and month but no year
what: The Past imports list (with its Undo button) and Your questions on Help and feedback show dates like 3 Jan without a year. After the first year an owner cannot tell an import from last January from one this January before tapping Undo.
expected: Dates older than this year show the year too, as the rest of the admin app does.
fix_line: Add the year to these dates when it is not this year.

items.reason: Web panel: install, sideload, Play and watch parts do not apply. Old tab after deploy is the shared panel fault; server older than page shows a calm not-switched-on card. No saved browser data in these screens to migrate.
